objective: Fix every finding in the October 11 Cortex audit without losing later approved behavior.

surfaces.acceptance: All deployed product files equal a source-pinned immutable candidate or are declared generated artifacts.
Deployed commit, remote accepted ref, manifest, test receipt, and rollback/redeploy proof match.
Trusted subagent routing completes; forged or missing trust fails closed.
Route outage produces a bounded, explicit failure without a 450-second chat freeze.
Trusted subagent completion callbacks persist expected lifecycle records without identity refusal.
Cortex API runs without unnecessary root/full capabilities or broad OpenClaw state writes; Oracle still works.
Static instructions, runtime, and memory agree on the later approved PMHNP OAuth decision, with the old rule superseded.
Static instructions, runtime, and memory agree on the later approved xhigh/default-service policy and documented exceptions.
Readiness, Sentinel, Meta Conductor, and per-level status classify the same observed state consistently.
Disabled-by-design and stale provider receipts are not misreported as component failure.
Parser initializes and passes a focused parse smoke or is intentionally disabled and reported honestly.
Supporting facts are not false conflicts and superseded execution-plane facts are historical, not co-current.
No-op timer runs avoid full verification work while preserving freshness and correctness.
Status, search, exact-page, fallback, and egress-policy focused smoke passes with bounded retries.
Intentional restarts do not generate false failed-unit evidence; genuine crashes still alert.
Obsolete units/jobs are disabled and quarantined with recovery notes; active user reminders are preserved.
Fresh bounded status/recovery proof is green without expanding AI OS authority.
Attachment policy remains functional while minimizing prompt-injection/tool exposure and documenting residual risk.
One clean full remote suite and focused security/routing/memory/browser checks pass on the exact deployed commit.
